name: ParentConferenceScheduler
tagline: Book every teacher of every child in one short, walkable parents' evening.
description: Parents' evening booking PCF control for schools: time × teacher grid for all of a family's teachers, one-click booking and moving, walking and video-changeover gaps, joint sibling appointments, teacher availability and breaks, an automatic Build my evening planner, itinerary with waiting time and topics, booking window rules and calendar export. Works in Power Pages, Canvas and Model-driven apps.
features: Time × teacher grid with reasons for every blocked time
Joint appointments for siblings with the same teacher
Build my evening: shortest evening with every teacher
Itinerary with walking/waiting time and topics to discuss
Booking window, booking limit, read-only mode
Calendar (.ics) export, 14 outputs and a Power Pages DOM event
Phone tabs, teacher cards and bottom-sheet editor
